wireRules.ids: opaque non-empty strings; UUID format is not part of the public contract
wireRules.timestamps: RFC3339 UTC timestamps; all freshness comparisons use server time
wireRules.unknownFields: reject security/authority objects; ignore only documented extension maps
wireRules.authority: homeId + homeMembershipId; role is membership-scoped; employee identity is never a household role

sessionId.description: Opaque identifier for the authenticated HttpOnly-cookie session; never a credential.

trustedDeviceId.description: Opaque identifier for the trusted installation bound to this session; never a signing key or credential.

token.description: Short-lived bearer. Native client memory only; never persist, log, render or forward to an unverified hub origin.
